Bring the application along with original and photocopy of certificates and testimonials for document verification.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for DHS Goa Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 2 December 2026, and candidates report at 9:30 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DHS Goa Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 26 vacancies: 1 Medical Programme Coordinator, 4 Research Coordinator, 1 Administrator-cum-Accountant, 16 Field Staff, 4 Laboratory Technician.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DHS Goa Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 2 December 2026 at 9:30 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Chamber of the Director, Directorate of Health Services, Campal, Panaji-Goa.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 45 years. Relaxation: As per Government orders Relaxable as per instructions/orders issued by the Government.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 85,000 for Medical Programme Coordinator, 35,000 for Research Coordinator, 30,000 for Administrator-cum-Accountant, 25,000 for Field Staff, 25,000 for Laboratory Technician.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MBBS with MD in Social & Preventive Medicine or MD in Community Medicine; MSc in Microbiology, Biotechnology or Biostatistics with 2 years research experience; B.Com with Tally; BSc in Microbiology, Biotechnology or Biostatistics; BSc with 6 months laboratory training course. Knowledge of Konkani essential for all posts. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Knowledge of Konkani is essential for all posts.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates reporting after 10.00 am / 2.30 pm will not be considered for interview.

faq.answer: Document verification. Walk-in interview. Candidates report for document verification and walk-in interview on the date specified for their post.
